summary: Retest of iteration_5 follow-ups. Backend: 10 new tests plus 12 iteration_5 regression tests, 22/22 PASS. Verified: delete_transactions (deleting your own pending record 200; others' pending and own approved 403; after granting the perm, deleting an approved record 200); edit_checks (PUT 200 with defaults; with the perm revoked PUT/PATCH status/endorse/DELETE all 403 and the check stays unchanged); view_reports (santiye_sefi 403 on /reports and /reports/export, muhasebe 200); PATCH progress status needs edit_progress (200, then 403 when revoked); close_if_paid revert (odendi -> onaylandi when net goes from 1000 to 2000); muhasebe editing an approved hakediş net -> taslak with reapproval_note, same-net edit keeps onaylandi, admin edit keeps onaylandi; tx kasa nakit->cek 400 'değiştirilemez', same kasa accepted. Frontend: admin sees nav-reports; TEST_ santiye_sefi has no Raporlar/Kasa nav on desktop or mobile; mobile 390 permissions-mobile stacked blocks visible with perm-m-* checkboxes, desktop table hidden, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390); user rows readable with the role select on its own line; desktop 1920 shows the perm-{role}-{key} table and hides the mobile block; progress-edit-button visible to admin on an odendi hakediş; AccountDetail labels follow the account's type even when the URL type does not match. All TEST_ data cleaned up and permissions restored to defaults.

minor.issue: Deleting a check that is linked to a transaction (transaction.check_id) leaves the transaction pointing at a check that no longer exists. Ciro'd checks are not blocked either.

ui_bugs.issue: A user without view_reports can open /raporlar directly. The page shell (filters, tabs) renders with an empty body, and /api/reports returns 403 with no 'yetkiniz yok' message and no redirect.

issues: Start/end use native <input type=date> showing mm/dd/yyyy in a Turkish app; consider the shadcn Calendar or a tr locale format

action_items: Optional: add a route guard or 'Yetkiniz yok' empty state on /raporlar when the user lacks view_reports
Optional: on DELETE /checks/{id}, block the delete or clear check_id on the linked transaction (and handle ciro_edildi checks)

Housekeeping: 3 leftover 'Test Muhasebe' users (muhasebe_18900a88@, muhasebe_6272a5de@, muhasebe_986c3b82@example.com, created 2026-10-21 by earlier runs) are still in the real users list; delete via DELETE /api/auth/users/{id}
critical_code_review_comments: core._perm_cache is per process. Fine with --workers 1, but with multiple workers or replicas a permission change will not invalidate the other caches; add a TTL or re-read on version.

set_status lets anyone with edit_progress set any status, including manually marking 'odendi' with no payments and approving their own hakediş. Consider restricting approval (taslak->onaylandi) to approve_expenses or the yönetici, since non-admin edits already force re-approval.
delete_tx own_pending covers 'reddedildi' as well (status != onaylandi). That is probably intended; just confirming.
